block-guide:
CORE/LATEST-POSTS A server-rendered list of the newest published posts (post type "post" only), with optional date, author, excerpt and featured image. One self-closing comment; no HTML, no inner blocks. For other post types, pagination or a custom card layout use core/query.
MARKUP (checked in the editor) <!-- wp:latest-posts {"postsToShow":3,"displayPostContent":true,"excerptLength":20,"displayPostDate":true,"displayFeaturedImage":true,"featuredImageSizeSlug":"medium","addLinkToFeaturedImage":true,"layout":{"type":"grid","columnCount":3}} /-->
OPTIONS postsToShow (default 5); order "desc"|"asc" with orderBy "date"|"title". categories: [{"id":12,"name":"News"}] — the id filters, the name is shown in the editor. selectedAuthor: a user id. displayPostContent:true shows text under each title: displayPostContentRadio "excerpt" (default, cut to excerptLength words, default 55) or "full_post". displayAuthor, displayPostDate: true adds the line. displayFeaturedImage:true with featuredImageSizeSlug (default "thumbnail"), featuredImageAlign "left"|"center"|"right", addLinkToFeaturedImage. Grid: "layout":{"type":"grid","columnCount":3}; without layout it is a plain list.
PITFALLS Sticky posts get no special place; drafts and private posts never appear. Posts without a featured image show none even when displayFeaturedImage is on.
CHECK Open the page: the newest posts appear with the parts that were switched on.
